Scene: seen from deep inside the cabin toward its wooden entrance door, which stands wide open onto a narrow wood-panelled ship corridor with brass wall lamps: Claire, a tall young French crew woman in a navy ankle-length uniform with brass buttons and a navy headscarf fully covering her hair and neck, stands outside in the corridor beyond the threshold with her arms folded; Yazan stands well inside the cabin near the bed, his hand still raised from opening the door, at least two arm's lengths away from her, his eyes reddened, looking at her warily; clear empty space between them; the balcony and sea are behind the viewer, not visible. Location: a surprisingly luxurious first-class cabin on the top deck of an old 1940s steamship, a large wooden bed with a cream cover, a tall wooden wardrobe, a small old-fashioned cabinet ice-box beside the bed, a woven rug on a wooden floor, glass doors open onto a small balcony with a wide view of the open sea. Camera: medium wide from inside the cabin toward the open door, both in the upper two-thirds, the wooden floor as a calm lower third.
Characters: Claire: a tall upright French woman of about 25 with fair skin, a long elegant face, calm green eyes and a composed serious expression; wears a long-sleeved high-collared ankle-length navy-blue 1940s ship crew uniform dress with brass buttons and a navy-blue headscarf tied snugly and fully covering her hair, hairline and neck, no hair visible. Yazan: a tall broad-shouldered Palestinian young man of 20 with light olive-brown skin, a handsome lean face, deep-set dark eyes under strong eyebrows, a light dark stubble and thick curly black hair; wears a loose long-sleeved earth-brown collarless cotton shirt, dark-brown trousers and a black-and-white checked keffiyeh draped around his neck and shoulders.
Mood/lighting: midday to afternoon, soft sea light through the balcony doors, deep loneliness and grief inside beauty.

shots.narration_dhivehi: ޔަޒަންނާ ދިމާލަށް ހަތަރުކަޅި ހަމަކޮށްގެންހުރެ އެއަންހެން ކުއްޖާ ބުނެލިއެވެ. "އާން. އެކަމަކު އަހަރެންނަކަށް ނޭނގެ އަހަރެންގެ ކުށަކީ ކޮބައި ކަމެއް؟
shots.narration_english: the woman said, standing facing Yazan with her arms folded. "Yes. But I don't know what my crime is,

shots.narration_dhivehi: އަސީރެއްގެ ގޮތުގައި މި ބޯޓަށް އަރުވަންޖެހުނު ސަބަބެއް ވެސް" އިސްދަށަށް ޖަހައިގެންހުރެ ޔަޒަން ބުނެލިއެވެ. "އަޅުގަނޑު ނާހަމައެއްނު ކީއްވެ ގެނައި އަސީރެއްތޯ އޭ.
shots.narration_english: or the reason I had to be put on this ship as a prisoner," Yazan said, standing with his head bowed. "I didn't ask why you were brought as a prisoner, did I?

shots.narration_dhivehi: އަޅުގަނޑަށް އެނގެޔޭ ކަން ހިނގައިގެން އުޅޭގޮތް. ހިންގާ ބެލްކަނީގައި އެހުރި ގޮނޑީގައި އިށީންދެލަން. ކަން ހިނގައިފައިވާ ގޮތާއި،
shots.narration_english: I know how things are going. Let's sit on the chairs out on the balcony. How things have happened,

shots.narration_dhivehi: ކަން ދެން ހިނގާނެ ގޮތް އަޅުގަނޑު ކިޔައިދޭނަން" ކޮޓަރީގެ އެތެރެއަށް ހިނގައިގަންނަމުން އެއަންހެން ކުއްޖާ ބުނެލިއެވެ.
shots.narration_english: and how things will happen next, I'll tell you," the woman said as she walked into the cabin.
